3:84.text: : "We believe in Allâh and in what has been sent down to us, and what was sent down to Ibrâhîm
[the offspring of the twelve sons of Ya‘qûb (Jacob)]
and what was given to Mûsâ
and the Prophets from their Lord. We make no distinction between one another among them and to Him

3:85.text: And whoever seeks a religion other than Islâm, it will never be accepted of him, and in the Hereafter he will be one of the losers

3:86.text: How shall Allâh guide a people who disbelieved after their belief and after they bore witness that the Messenger
is true and after clear proofs had come unto them? And Allâh guides not the people who are Zâlimûn

3:87.text: They are those whose recompense is that on them
the Curse of Allâh, of the angels, and of all mankind.

3:88.text: . Neither will their torment be lightened, nor will it be delayed or postponed

3:89.text: Except for those who repent after that and do righteous deeds. Verily, Allâh is Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful.

3:90.text: Verily, those who disbelieved after their Belief and then went on increasing in their disbelief
(i.e. disbelief in the Qur’ân and in Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم)
- never will their repentance be accepted
[because they repent only by their tongues and not from their hearts]
. And they are those who are astray.

3:91.text: Verily, those who disbelieved, and died while they were disbelievers, the
earth full of gold will not be accepted from anyone of them even if they offered it as a ransom
. For them is a painful torment and they will have no helpers.
